headline: A 2016 law renames the federal building and courthouse at 511 East San Antonio Avenue in El Paso, Texas, after R.E. Thomason.
what_it_does: The law gives an official new name to a federal building and United States courthouse in El Paso, Texas. The building will be called the R.E. Thomason Federal Building and United States Courthouse. It does not change how the building is used, who works there, or what cases the court hears.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 8, 2016.
